$comment: The four (default) MCP servers the host loads. Values may carry ${VARIABLES}: anything
from the environment, plus ${REPO_ROOT} and ${WORKSPACE}, which the manager injects.
A server whose variables are not set is reported and skipped, never guessed at.
The filesystem and git servers are pointed at the scratch workspace on purpose, so the
demonstration of other MCPs cannot touch this repository: the filesystem server
enforces that root itself, and the git server is launched inside it so its relative
paths land there. Note that `mcp-server-git` takes an explicit repo_path per call and
dies at startup if --repository is not already a repository, so it gets neither.
The two fraud entries are the same server on two transports: the host opens one of
them, never both, so the six tools keep their documented names.

filesystem.description: Official Filesystem server (Anthropic), restricted to the workspace

git.description: Official Git server (Anthropic), run straight from PyPI with uvx

fraud-local.description: This project's fraud monitoring server, as a subprocess over stdio

fraud-remote.description: The very same server, deployed and reached over HTTPS
